# Emergency Procedures
During an emergency, Corporate Security has authority over all Company staff on site, under the senior employee.
## Lockdown - The Sergeant may lock down the corporate offices and the laboratory at any time. - During a lockdown, officers hold the entrances and admit only Company staff. - Staff caught outside are brought to the nearest secure room.
## Hostile Intrusion - Officers move to protect, in order: senior executives, research staff and data, specimens, then all other staff and property. - Office and research staff are moved away from the threat and locked in. Officers may not use them as a shield or a distraction. - Officers report the threat's position and strength on the Company radio channel.
## Evacuation When the senior employee orders an evacuation: - Officers escort staff to the landing zone in this order: the senior employee, research staff and their data, all other staff. - Sensitive material that can't be carried is destroyed before officers leave. - Officers secure the landing zone until the Company shuttle has left. Officers board last. - Nobody who isn't Company staff boards a Company shuttle without the senior employee's permission.
## Personal Protection in an Emergency - The detail stays with its executive and takes them to safety by the route the Coordinator chooses. - The detail's only task is the executive's safety. It doesn't join the wider response unless the Coordinator orders it.
